messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — Jamal's birthday this Friday! Planning a little office brunch around 11am in the kitchen. Cake or bagels?
Jamal: omg surprise :) no pressure, I'm easy. Bagels sound great tbh.
Priya: Bagels + cream cheese please. I can bring coffee (decaf + regular). :coffee:
Ava: I'll bring a small chocolate cake if others prefer cake. Otherwise I can bring croissants.
Zoe: I'm remote that day, can we do a Zoom toast at 11:05? Would love to sing badly. :party_parrot:
People Ops Bot: Reminder set — office birthday notification scheduled for 2025-04-10 10:45 PDT. RSVP in the sheet: https://rwd.in/sheet/bday-jamal
Liam: I'll handle balloons + napkins. Any dietary restrictions? Jamal — any allergies?
Jamal: No allergies, but low sugar would be appreciated :) Also pls no nuts, they're fine but I'd rather avoid.
Maya: Noted. @Liam please avoid the mixed nut box. @Priya thanks for coffee. Who wants to sign up for bringing plates/cutlery? Add to sheet.
Priya: signed up for coffee + 8 cups.
Ava: Cake confirmed. Bringing candles :candle:
Zoe: I'll hop on Zoom at 11:05 for the singalong. Send link?
Maya: Zoom link added to the calendar invite. Thanks everyone! :tada:
